title: MedOmni-45°: A Safety–Performance Benchmark for Reasoning-Oriented LLMs in Medicine

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness by appending seven types of manipulative hint conditions (such as User Suggestion Bias, Evaluation Context Bias, and Questionable Source Hint) to medical multiple-choice questions, and measuring whether the model changes its initially correct answer to conform to the misleading cues.
